verify_r84_review.py.description: Standard-library structural audit of the frozen R84 repository evidence

blocking_findings: The latest R84 source snapshot is not a completed review-ready package; the ordinary-LaTeX publication workflow was queued at the review freeze.
The active title and historical platform remain broader than the finite first-date, finite-menu, common-continuation R84 transfer.
Correctness and economic transfer are method-neutral; the revision does not identify a specifically neural advantage.
The common-readout result is finite-catalogue compatibility, not an unseen-state or new-task generalization theorem.
The exact menu winner is an ex post finite-catalogue result and lacks a distinct prospective workload evaluation.
Deterministic work and complete wall-clock time disagree in the harder task.
Direct original-law policy-cost contrasts remain unresolved in sign.
The assignment separation is conditional on externally declared resource prices and fees rather than an estimated economic gain.
Service reliability is protected by conventional fallback and does not identify predictor reliability; 48 warnings remain.
The inherited two-control computation still exhibits severe horizon growth.
The independent audit is not yet jointly bound to a completed publication build or an independent implementation of the heaviest kernels.
The mathematical novelty is useful but not commensurate with the breadth and cumulative scale of the manuscript.
limitations: The advisory review did not refit models, rerun Bellman services, create new policy-cost observations, or repeat wall-clock measurements.
The structural verifier is not a formal proof assistant and is not an independent implementation of the full numerical kernels.
The latest R84 ordinary-LaTeX package, visual inspection, clean rebuild, and final delivery manifest were not available at the review freeze.
Timing observations are single-environment descriptive measurements.
positive_findings: The actionwise theorem maps optimization sublevels into original-law cost bands under explicit finite-menu and common-continuation assumptions.
The economic stopping frontier correctly separates numerical tolerances from economic decision margins.
A single rational readout is actually evaluated across both declared context catalogues.
The full menu retains ordinary, hybrid, analytic, learned, and adverse services with complete-cost accounting.
The rational assignment primal-dual certificate is exact for the declared finite problem.
The independent exact-arithmetic audit checks the new winners, joint events, and economic duals without importing the construction module or an LP solver.
The source-delivery note honestly distinguishes scientific execution from a completed publication package.
recommendation: Reject in the present form and do not continue this cumulative manuscript through another ordinary revision round. A sharply focused paper on economically targeted stopping and certificate-gated Bellman search could merit evaluation, but R84 still does not establish an Econometrica-level neural, computational, or economic advantage, and the latest source snapshot is not a completed review-ready submission.
